Sapere com'è una RM lombare normale serv:
Knowing what a normal lumbar MRI looks like helps you recognise disease: tall discs with a bright nucleus on T2, aligned posterior walls, vertebral bodies with homogeneous signal, a wide canal with bright CSF on T2.
Fat-suppressed T2 (or STIR) makes fat and normal marrow dark, so that oedema, recent fractures, infection and Modic 1 stand out.
In most cases of low back pain MRI is not the first step. Guidelines reserve it for patients with red flags or with symptoms persisting despite treatment, when the result may change management. Many people without pain have degenerated discs or bulges: routine MRI leads to unnecessary diagnoses and treatments.
Lombalgia senza segnali d'allarme: prima: Low back pain without red flags: clinical assessment first, MRI only if it changes management.
Gradazioni del radiologo muscoloscheletr: Grading by the SPIDER collection musculoskeletal radiologist: all levels Pfirrmann 1, with no herniation, bulge, endplate changes or listhesis.

Nella lombalgia aspecifica senza segnali: In non-specific low back pain without red flags it is not needed in the first weeks; it is needed with red flags (neurological deficits, cauda equina syndrome, fever, known cancer, trauma, weight loss) or when surgery is being considered
È l'indicazione delle principali linee g: This is the recommendation of the main guidelines (for example ACR Appropriateness Criteria and NICE): early MRI without red flags does not improve outcome and often finds clinically irrelevant findings.
